[Unit]

After=network-online.target

User=lmdeploy
Group=lmdeploy
WorkingDirectory=/var/lib/lmdeploy

RestartSec=5

WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

The repository is cloned into `{{INSTALL_DIR}}/flux`, a Python 3.12 virtual environment is created, all required packages are installed, and the Streamlit demo (`demo_st.py`) is run on port 8940.

> **NOTE**
> The original installation on this machine uses the CPU‑only build of PyTorch (`torch==2.14.1+cpu`).
> If you want GPU acceleration you will need to install a CUDA‑enabled PyTorch wheel (e.g. `torch==2.14.1+cu124`) and optionally the TensorRT dependencies.  The steps below install the CPU variant; see the *Optional GPU support* section for guidance.

## Step 1: System prerequisites

Why: The project requires Python 3.12, pip, and git.

```requires
os: linux
arch: x64
gpu: nvidia
min_ram_gb: 8
min_disk_gb: 20
min_driver: 617.42
```

```detect bash
test -x /usr/bin/python3.12
```

```install bash
apt-get update
apt-get install -y python3.12 python3.12-venv python3.12-dev pyt-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev-dev

# Peertube install

This install script sets up Peertube on a clean Ubuntu 24.04 LTS machine using Docker Compose. It pulls the official Peertube image, creates the required volumes, and starts the containers. The service will be available on port **8380**.

The installation is idempotent: each step checks whether it is already done and skips if so.

## Step 1: Install Docker Engine

Why: Peertube runs in Docker containers.

```requires
os: linux
arch: x64
min_disk_gb: 20
min_ram_gb: 4
```

```detect bash
# Docker Engine already installed?
docker --version 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'Docker version'
```

```install bash
# Add Docker’s official GPG key and set up the stable repository
apt-get update
apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg
mkdir -p /etc/apt/keyrings
curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg

# Set up the repository
echo "deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu $(lsb_release -cs) stable" | tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list > /-extra-extra-extra-extra-extra
